{"consolidated_memory":"STALE STATE IN CACHE SLICE - TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: ui/state/cacheSlice.ts (web ui side, TypeScript)
Shared symptom across both: stale state in the cache slice
Shared repro: edit a record then navigate back to the list
Shared signal: old value still in the store snapshot
Shared test coverage: ui/state/cacheSlice.test.ts

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-17]:
- Specific trigger: stale state appeared only on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #8748 on branch fix/stale-state-1
- Measured outcome: cold start performance improved by 80%, dropping to 881 ms

INCIDENT 2 [2026-07-23]:
- Specific trigger: stale state appeared only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: cache entry was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #8961 on branch fix/stale-state-2
- Measured outcome: alert stayed quiet for 62 consecutive days following the fix"}
